freeze_timing: before any Experiment-2 performance is observed

gates.name: DATA / INTEGRITY
gates.scope: DATA HEALTH only; no performance criterion
all_required: complete official TRAIN compressed stream and gzip completion/trailer validated
complete TAR traversal and final source total/validator/hash record
every complete scenario inventoried in actual parsed order; objectively corrupt scenarios fully logged
no unreadable required Camera/Seg/IMU modalities among accepted scenarios
aligned Camera/Seg/IMU ticks under unchanged loader; finite required sensor values
source/member hashes and clean-block schema/code/window/provenance bound
town/environment diversity reported with missing descriptors explicit; no balancing/drop rule
deterministic FULL-TRAIN whole-scenario partition frozen once; nonempty FIT and CAL
zero TEST access and protected role exclusion
storage/runtime completion not merely a partial prefix
gates.pass: all predicates true and inventory/provenance/partition sealed
gates.failure: STOP; no fitting; preserve evidence and report exact failed integrity predicate; no performance-based exclusion

gates.name: TRAIN-ONLY SCIENTIFIC HEALTH
gates.authorization: fitting requires separate human authorization after Gate 1 PASS
gates.upstream_fit: new FIT_NORMAL clean only; unchanged one-class/bootstrap algorithms
gates.mapping_fit: new CAL_NORMAL clean + new CAL-derived modality-matched pseudo only; scenario isolated; no FIT graph pseudo used to calibrate

audit_source.contract: unchanged optimization_info finite_optimum/separation/profile audit and require_valid(diagnostic=False); diagnostic=True permits evidence recording only, never an invalid scientific prediction channel

diagnostics_required_per_modality: all accepted calibration audit fields including separation geometry, optimizer convergence, stationarity/curvature, absolute/relative slope profiles and boundary trends
score and calibrated probability ranges, finite counts and saturation counts
member score/probability disagreement and canonical epistemic/aleatoric distribution summaries
CAL clean-vs-pseudo separation and class-specific distributions
exact constant-output checks on combined clean/pseudo probabilities and feature/score outputs
provenance/sample counts/recipe roles and scenario isolation

decision_order.predicate: nonfinite required features/member scores/probabilities/UQ/parameters, or probability/UQ domain failure under unchanged scientific implementation
accepted unchanged audit reports strict/weak separability, suspected separation, improving boundary/direction profile or otherwise absent finite optimum with structural nonexistence evidence

audit finite_optimum is false without structural diagnosis, missing/incomplete audit/provenance, no supported CAL classes, or exact constant predictive output over combined clean+modality-matched pseudo task
accepted require_valid succeeds, all required finite/domain/provenance predicates pass and no exact constant predictive collapse; range/saturation/disagreement diagnostics explicitly reported

noncriteria: no minimum pseudo AUROC/ECE improvement invented
zero/tiny canonical epistemic uncertainty is retained and reported; no amplification or guaranteed nonzero-UQ gate
saturation fractions and pseudo separation are diagnostic, not proof of real anomaly performance or an excuse to change severities
gates.invalid_any_active_modality: STOP before graph construction/GAT training; write methodology-decision report; no automatic repair; repair belongs to separately preregistered Experiment 2B
gates.pass: all three modalities explicitly VALID and sealed audit/provenance report
gates.pseudo_interpretation: TRAIN pseudo discrimination is development diagnostic only; never real anomaly performance evidence

gates.name: PRE-FINAL DEVELOPMENT
gates.entry: Gate 1 and Gate 2 PASS plus separately authorized, frozen FULL-TRAIN graph protocol
gates.development_sources: Experiment-2 official TRAIN FIT-derived graph training/validation only; upstream CAL reserved for mapping; no official TEST or FINAL-SIM

NoGraph.architecture: bias-free shared Linear(3,12) -> ELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> bias-free Linear(12,1); mean(sigmoid(node_logit))
NoGraph.implementation: future report/adapter-side classifier; frozen core identity NoGraph remains unchanged
NoGraph.name: NoGraph shared-node MLP, distinct from frozen identity NoGraph plugin
NoGraph.reason: trainable nonlinear baseline with 48 parameters against 50 in each GAT; no deliberate information/capacity deficit

GAT_architecture.dropout_location: post-softmax normalized attention, exactly existing layer
GAT_architecture.final_activation: linear node logits; sigmoid only for node probability
GAT_architecture.initialization: Xavier uniform for every W and attention vector; identical cloned tensors per Standard/Epistemic seed
GAT_architecture.pooling: q_normal=mean_i sigmoid(z_i); no extra fusion, belief or decision layer

epistemic_attention.floating_point: reuse existing float32 prior/log implementation; tiny E can round to a neutral prior; accept weak/null effects without post-result amplification
epistemic_attention.monotonic: for fixed learned logits and other senders, increasing E_j decreases its normalized attention to each eligible receiver before dropout
epistemic_attention.neutral: use_epistemic_prior=False gives w=1; if every E=0 both attention operators coincide
epistemic_attention.scope: same original canonical E_j at both layers; sender prior only, no receiver factor
epistemic_attention.units: E is canonical entropy-gap in nats, not variance or its square root

early_stopping.checkpoint: independently save actual lowest validation BCE among executed epochs, earliest epoch on exact tie
early_stopping.monitor_tracker: reset only if loss < tracked_best-min_delta; update tracked_best only on such improvement

training_specification.loss: mean BCE(q_normal,target_normal) over graph-training samples; no node-label auxiliary loss
training_specification.shuffle: PCG64(seed+zero_based_epoch_index); same row keys and permutation across all methods
training_specification.validation_loss: equal-scenario mean BCE over the NEW frozen graph-validation scenario list

threshold_rule.candidate_set: sorted unique validation p_corruption values union {0,1}
threshold_rule.objective: maximize arithmetic mean of per-validation-scenario corruption F1
threshold_rule.optimism: threshold selection and reported validation F1 use the same validation data; report as development statistics, not confirmatory evaluation
threshold_rule.select_using: graph validation only, separately for each method and seed at its selected checkpoint

graph_membership_plan.planned_rule: sorted new FIT IDs; permute once, n_graph_val=max(1,round(0.20*n_fit)) with Python ties-to-even; first n_graph_val IDs validation, remainder graph train; CAL excluded; no old memberships copied
graph_membership_plan.derivation: same historical 3-of-15 validation fraction and seed, scaled deterministically to new FIT size; bind exact membership under separate FULL-TRAIN graph protocol before any graph performance
graph_membership_plan.pseudo: inherits parent graph role; five non-GNSS recipe order/default severities unchanged; no CAL pseudo reuse
graph_membership_plan.conditional_validation_limit: upstream one-class representation fitted all FIT scenarios including graph validation; development scores are not full-pipeline unseen-scenario evidence

failure_rules: keep all failed runs and reasons; no seed replacement/best-seed selection
nonfinite predictions/states or source/role/determinism violation => STOP final access and report
no minimum graph AUROC or requirement that EpistemicGAT wins
near-chance/null results retained; representation/pseudo repair is a new numbered experiment
missing planned seed invalidates complete paired aggregation; no hidden omission
pre_final_freeze_required: analysis plan and separate three contrasts
separately frozen fresh final scenario/seed specification
gates.pass: complete authorized development with all required hashes/analysis/failure ledger frozen and no unresolved integrity/numeric violation; scientific null results do not redefine the gate
gates.after_pass: separate final-evaluation authorization only; no final dataset access now

methodology_changes: separately preregistered numbered Experiment 2B or later; never an invisible rescue
